Several entries assign the opposite tail from the reviewed question: question 14 (`qrow_9709_s20_qp_62_q02`) tests whether the Grade A proportion has increased but is included here as lower-tailed, while question 13 (`qrow_9709_s20_qp_61_q04`) tests whether the expected spinner score is less than 3 and defaults to upper-tailed; `qrow_9709_w23_qp_63_q07` similarly tests whether the pollutant mean is below 0.5 but defaults to upper-tailed. Since `_semantic_posture` copies this result into every approved part and procedure instance, the committed ledger, delta, and cumulative projection expose incorrect test directions and can route downstream solutions to the wrong probability tail.
